title: Application API Gateway Kong Entity
description: Kong-specific configuration. Extends Application/APIGateway with Kong-specific settings.

database.description: Database backend. Use 'off' for DB-less declarative mode.

password_secret.description: Doorman secret reference for database password.

declarative_config.description: Path to declarative YAML config file (used in DB-less mode).

plugins.description: Enabled plugins (e.g., rate-limiting, key-auth, jwt, oauth2, cors, acl).

admin_listen.description: Admin API listener address and port (e.g., '127.0.0.1:8001').

status_listen.description: Status API listener address and port (e.g., '0.0.0.0:8100').

nginx_worker_processes.description: Number of Nginx worker processes (e.g., 'auto' or a number).
